concerns_addressed: Implementer concerns: none. Confirmed router username message is ASCII hyphen-minus U+002D and oauth username message is EN DASH U+2013, both byte-identical to base 63510672901aa9808d7ea77bd939b2eeaa6c99fd. No fieldErrors. No status(400) remains in router.ts or oauth.ts.

strengths: Both router username checks are one usernameSchema(REGISTER_USERNAME_MESSAGE); oauth reuses that wrapper with OAUTH_USERNAME_MESSAGE. Messages toEqual-pinned, including dashes (router test U+002D, oauth test U+2013 plus explicit \u2013).

Schemas wrap validateUsername, USERNAME_RE, and validateDisplayName. They do not reimplement length, regex, or trim. Password stays untrimmed; login does not trim. Success path returns the validator trimmed username/displayName (empty displayName stays undefined so register still falls back to the trimmed username).

Zod 4.4.3 (server/package.json ^4.4.3, installed node_modules/zod 4.4.3): $ZodCustom.parse is identity and the check receives payload.value (v4/core/schemas.js). Pipe skips transform when the check fails. Reconstructed schema safeParse rejects ["abc"] instead of coercing it to "abc", so non-strings still reach the validators via value ?? "". { error: message } becomes the issue message through normalizeParams/finalizeIssue. parseWith is called without fieldErrors, so sendValidationError bodies are { error } only.
Register order is username, then password, then displayName, with req.body ?? {} kept on register, login, and oauth. First failure wins, covered by both-invalid and password-before-displayName cases.

Diff is only the five in-scope files. auth-schemas.ts is 83 lines, uses NodeNext .js imports, and is not exported from index.ts. oauth.test.ts is untouched. router.ts shrank 198 to 189 lines; no modified file crosses ~300 and no function newly exceeds ~50.
